headline: Newtown Home Buying Tip
subhead: Understand Connecticut property taxes and mill rates before you make an offer.
caption: October is a wonderful time to look at homes in Newtown, CT, but as you tour properties, remember to factor in local property taxes. In Connecticut, towns fund public services through property taxes based on local mill rates. When you are looking at homes, checking the specific mill rate for Newtown helps you calculate a more accurate monthly payment so there are no surprises after closing. A clear budget makes the whole purchasing process much smoother. If you have questions about navigating the local market this season, feel free to reach out. Call or text Jaskaran Singh with Vylla Home.
